Show plan content in plans view — expand card or detail view
────────────────────────────────────────
ULID:      01KK2T7CVKTKWAG10MJFZHQXYK
Type:      task
Status:    pending
Priority:  2
Automation: eligible

─── Description ───
  The /plans page shows plan metadata (title, status, progress, spec/task counts) but not the actual plan content text. Plans have a content field with the full markdown plan document. Add: (1) an expandable section on each plan card, or a click-to-open detail view, that renders the plan content as formatted markdown, (2) ensure the daemon GET /api/plans endpoint returns the content field (check if it's currently omitted for payload size), (3) if content is large, consider lazy-loading it on expand rather than including in the list response.
Spec ref:  @ui-plans-view
Tags:      bug, web-ui
Created:   2026-03-07T00:12:45.811Z

─── Spec Context ───
Plans View
Type: feature
Implementation: implemented
Description:
  View for browsing plan records with progress tracking via linked specs and tasks.
Acceptance Criteria:
  [ac-1]
    Given: Plan records exist

    When: The user navigates to /plans

    Then: Each plan shows title, status, creation date, linked spec/task counts,
and progress based on task completion status

  [ac-2]
    Given: A plan card on the /plans page
    When: The user expands or clicks into the plan
    Then: The full plan content renders as formatted markdown, loaded on demand if not already in the list payload
